statement: Subscription publishers never block on a slow subscriber. Queue overflow discards the potentially gapped backlog and emits one lag marker by itself; the consumer must fetch fresh catalog/session state rather than continue as if no event were lost. Catalog-only subscriptions exclude high-volume terminal and Pi streams.
consequence: A subscriber could otherwise continue from incomplete state and present a stale or inconsistent session catalog as live.

enforcedAt.trigger: A subscriber queue fills or event scopes are selected
